entities.name: Whisper
entities.description: Human Cabal cleric from Estark, cruel and charismatic favored priest of the demonlord.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: Cult on Dominaria served by Whisper.

entities.name: Legacy Curse
entities.description: Curse afflicting a victim's entire bloodline.

entities.name: Knight-Sergeant Leobard
entities.description: Benalish leader who drove the Cabal out.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: Capashen struck by the cursed blade.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Cabal member to whom Whisper passed the blade.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker identified by Whisper as an invader.

events.summary: Whisper enchanted a blade with the Legacy Curse and led the Cabal in a raid on Seven Sisters.
events.quote: Whisper enchanted a blade with the Legacy Curse

events.summary: Leobard led Benalish forces to drive Whisper and the Cabal out of the village.
events.quote: Knight-Sergeant Leobard led Benalish forces to drive her and the Cabal out of the village.

events.summary: Whisper passed the blade to Josu Vess, who cursed the Capashen bloodline by striking Danitha.
events.quote: Josu Vess , who successfully struck Danitha with it

events.summary: Rafwyn Capashen lifted the curse after Josu was destroyed.
events.quote: Rafwyn Capashen was able to lift its curse

events.summary: Whisper identified Gideon as an invader in the fighting pit.
events.quote: Whisper identified Gideon as an invader

events.summary: During the prisoner rebellion Radha killed Whisper.
events.quote: During the prisoner rebellion she was killed by Radha

relations.quote: Whisper was a human cleric of The Cabal on Dominaria .
she passed the blade to Josu Vess
